en-US.connect_once_body: FirstMate is not saved on this device yet. Connect to the internet and open it once. After that it opens without a connection.

en-US.ind_ready_long: FirstMate is saved on this device. It now opens without a connection.
en-US.tray_none: Nothing is waiting. Everything you changed has been sent.
en-US.tray_storage_warning_title: This browser may clear waiting changes
en-US.tray_storage_warning: This browser has not promised to keep what FirstMate saves. It can clear it when the device runs low on space, and Safari clears a site's storage after seven days without a visit. Changes still waiting here would be lost, so connect and send them soon. The FirstMate app does not have this limit.
en-US.entry_discard_ask: Discard this change? It was never sent and will be lost.
en-US.entry_action_failed: That did not work. Try again.

error_refused.message: The server did not accept this change ({status}).

en-US.error_not_found: What this change was for no longer exists.
en-US.error_forbidden: You are not allowed to make this change.
en-US.error_server: The server had a problem. Retry in a moment.
en-US.error_parked: This change was made under another sign-in. Sign in as that person to send it.
en-US.conflict_intro: This was changed here and on the server before your change could be sent. Choose which value to keep for each field.

conflict_remaining.message: {count, plural, one {# field left to choose} other {# fields left to choose}}

en-US.conflict_failed: Your choices could not be saved. Try again.
en-US.badge_waiting_tip: Saved on this device. It is sent when you reconnect.
en-US.badge_failed_tip: This was not sent. Open to retry or discard it.
en-US.badge_conflict_tip: This was also changed on the server. Open to choose what to keep.
en-US.project_not_saved: This project is not saved on this device.
en-US.project_downloading: Saving this project on this device…
en-US.project_auto: Kept automatically because you opened it recently. The ten most recent projects are kept.
en-US.project_chosen: You chose to keep this project on this device.
en-US.project_waits_for_connection: It will be saved when you reconnect.
en-US.project_failed: That did not work. Try again.

en-US.set_reads_help: How much project data to keep. The oldest is removed first. Projects you keep are never removed.
en-US.set_media_help: How many pictures to keep for viewing without a connection.
en-US.set_auto_pin_help: The ten projects you opened last are saved on this device automatically.
en-US.set_camera_roll: Also save photos to the camera roll
en-US.set_camera_roll_help: Photos you take in FirstMate stay in the app. Turn this on to save a copy to your phone's photos as well.

en-US.set_remove: Remove saved data from this device
en-US.set_remove_help: Removes saved projects, pictures and pages from this device, including projects you chose to keep. They are saved again when you open them with a connection. Changes waiting to be sent are kept and still sent.
en-US.set_remove_ask: Remove saved data now? Changes waiting to be sent are kept.
en-US.set_removed: Saved data was removed. Waiting changes were kept.
en-US.set_remove_failed: Saved data could not be removed. Try again.
en-US.set_save_failed: That setting could not be saved. Try again.

signout_body.message: {count, plural, one {# change has not been sent yet.} other {# changes have not been sent yet.}} If you sign out now they stay on this device and are sent the next time you sign in here.

en-US.tray_saved_copy_note: It may be older than what the server has now. Load the latest when you are ready.
